rationale: Direct scholarly and official orthographic evidence.

International technical stem adapted; exact biconditional defined from OLP-0005, not canon.

Includes subset plus inequality, never used for arbitrary subset.
Calque corresponding to standard regional mathematical term; defined as all subsets, not a numerical exponent.
Explicit two directions; do not collapse to yen. Mathematical semantics from English.
Empty set has no members; empty string has length zero. Keep distinctions in definitions.
General bukti homonym 2 and verbal form attested. Formal mathematical argument sense derives from source. Unaccented e follows edition policy.
Bener and contrasting kleru general evidence; use salah for false consistently in formal contexts. No formal truth-value canon attestation claimed.
Includes 0 in OLP; avoid silently adopting positive-only convention.
Defined by Z display including negatives and zero; not attested here as a technical phrase.
Retain international recognizable stems; sets fixed by English formulas.
Cardinality/sequence finitude as defined in English; not merely numerical boundedness. Reassess at order/boundedness chapters.
Keep finite string and potentially infinite sequence distinct; alphabet defined explicitly.
Borrowed regional mathematical forms; union inclusive OR, intersection AND; canon not claimed as technical attestation.

Order matters; product uses all ordered pairs.
Technical borrowing; naive is not an insult or claim of mathematical carelessness.
Defined directly in OLP-0005 with positive-divisor example; no canonical native mathematical attestation claimed.
General relasi directly observed in Javanese philosophical prose. Formal binary relation sense defined by OLP-0012 as subset of A squared, not by canon.
No native formal-relation attestation acquired. Exact quantified conditions follow OLP-0014. Irreflexive must not be equated with merely not reflexive.
Three distinct terms for three distinct quantified conditions; source examples and distinction paragraph control their meaning.
Connected relation means comparability of distinct elements; reserve kasambungan graf for graph connectivity. Tatanan is an editorial specialization, not attested here in order theory.

english: identity relation / universal relation / empty relation
javanese: relasi identitas / relasi universal / relasi kosong
rationale: Defined explicitly by diagonal, A squared, and empty set respectively. Philosophical discussion distinguishes representing a relation by a set from metaphysical identity.
Terms used in OLP-0010; source specifies comprehension, contradictory membership and axiomatic existence conditions. No technical native attestation claimed.
Conventional technical stems adapted provisionally. Environment labels retain source hierarchy; proposition in philosophy differs from numbered proposition environment by context.

javanese: relasi ekuivalensi / kelas ekuivalensi / kuosien / partisi
rationale: Defined directly from OLP-0015, including reflexive/symmetric/transitive criteria and set of equivalence classes. No native mathematical attestation claimed.

english: preorder / partial order / total or linear order
javanese: pratatanan / tatanan parsial / tatanan total utawa linear
rationale: Preserve source hierarchy and strict versus non-strict forms. Pra- plus tatanan is an editorial coinage with uncertainty, not alleged established terminology.
Operation adding diagonal, sequence extension, and prefix sense defined directly in OLP-0016. Tutupan is not assumed attested as an algebraic closure term.

javanese: graf / graf mawa arah / simpul / rusuk
rationale: Formal graph vocabulary defined from OLP-0017; no native graph-theory attestation acquired. Isolated vertices retained.

english: tree / root / ancestor / child / parent / branch / subtree
javanese: wit / oyod / leluhur / anak / induk / pang / subwit
rationale: Controlled native metaphors and compositional terms, defined by OLP-0018; neither botanical nor kinship senses alone attest the formal senses.

english: least element / well-ordered / successor / predecessor / chain
javanese: anggota paling cilik / katata kanthi becik / panerus / pandhisik / rantai
rationale: Source definitions control: least compares to all, well-order quantifies over every nonempty subset, and successor/predecessor here are immediate. No unwarranted exact-one predecessor for infinite limit nodes.

english: inverse / relative product / restriction / application / transitive closure
javanese: invers / produk relatif / watesan / aplikasi / tutupan transitif
rationale: Operations follow OLP-0019 exactly. Relative product order is R then S; restriction intersects A squared; R+ notation is section-local and differs from reflexive closure notation in OLP-0016.

javanese: winates cacah paneruse ing saben simpul
rationale: Explicit per-node finiteness avoids confusing finite branching with finite branch length or finitely many total branches. Replaces ambiguous mawa pange winates before acceptance.

javanese: formula / derivasi / kelengkapan / logika tataran kapisan
rationale: Formula, derivasi and kelengkapan are declared technical adaptations; tataran kapisan is a descriptive choice. Further definitions will follow original relevant chapters. Derivation remains distinct from proof (bukti).

Fungsi has general-purpose usage in the scholarly witness, not an attested mapping sense. Define unique output for each domain member directly from OLP-0021; pemetaan is a disclosed regional technical borrowing.

english: domain / codomain / range / argument / value / input / output
javanese: domain / kodomain / jangkauan / argumen / nilai / masukan / asil
rationale: Keep codomain distinct from attained range. Asil is descriptive for output; nilai is assigned value. Formal meanings follow OLP-0021, no native mathematical attestation claimed.

english: surjective / injective / bijective; surjection / injection / bijection
javanese: surjektif / injektif / bijektif; surjeksi / injeksi / bijeksi
rationale: Maintain source token keys/flags. Quantifiers distinguish at least one, at most one, and exactly one preimage. Adjectival tokens follow fungsi in Javanese; English article flags are suppressed for adjectives only.
Controlled borrowing and general scholarly relasi/fungsi evidence only. Exact graph, uniqueness/totality and image definitions translated directly from OLP-0023; image is a set, not a picture.

english: inverse; left inverse; right inverse; composition
javanese: invers; invers kiwa; invers tengen; komposisi
rationale: Technical stems adapted within Javanese prose; no canon claim for these mathematical senses. OLP-0024 and OLP-0025 control sided equations and the order first f then g. Empty-domain source exception is explicitly documented.

english: partial function; total; defined; undefined; serial
javanese: fungsi parsial; total; ditetepake; ora ditetepake; serial
rationale: OLP-0026 directly defines at most one output, actual domain, and seriality. Keep at most one distinct from exactly one; total refers to all of the ambient input set A. No specialized attestation inferred from general fungsi usage.

Freshly read recovered official KBJI originals confirm these lexical senses. They do not attest every mathematical compound. Preserve OpenLogic Nat including zero; old textbook wilangan asli excluding zero is not imported.

Fresh recovered original HTML confirms the operation senses. OLP-0021 now uses ping-pingan in place of provisional perkalian. Pamara means way of dividing, not divisor; total-function and union terminology are separate.

english: numerical power; power set; algebraic or logical term
javanese: rambang (numerical alternative); himpunan pangkat (retained); technical term undecided
rationale: Rambang directly attests equal-factor numerical powers, not powersets. Keep prior himpunan pangkat decision. Suku entry lacks an explicit algebraic/logical-term definition. Recovered rambang original HTML itself flattens its displayed example to 43; never use that as mathematical evidence.

javanese: enumerasi; bisa didhaptar; enumerabilitas; bisa dietung (countable sense, source-defined)
rationale: Cacah attests general count/quantity, not countable infinity. Enumerable is rendered bisa didhaptar, with every element at a finite position and empty-set case controlled by English. Enumerations need not be computable. Preserve distinction between surjective-list and bijective alternative versions.

Directly render OLP-0029 rounding upward to the nearest integer. No specialized native dictionary attestation or pronunciation certification claimed; preserve the ceiling brackets and negative-input meaning.

javanese: fungsi pasangan; ngodeake; kode; ngudhari kode
rationale: OLP-0031 defines pairing as an injection from A times B to Nat; preserve this broad definition, with a separate erratum qualifying the inverse-enumeration exercise. No native technical attestation claimed.
Co- prefix adapted to ko- plus chosen winates; explicitly means complement in Nat is finite, not infinite. Source wording omission is recorded rather than allowed to redefine Nat as finite.

english: array; row; column; triangular number; numerical power
javanese: larikan rong dimensi; baris; kolom; wilangan segitiga; rambang
rationale: Array labels and triangular-number terminology are source-defined provisional forms; gunggung supports numerical sum and rambang directly supports numerical powers. Do not transfer rambang to powerset. English ordinal th in OLP-0031 is rendered by preceding kaping; its text-only TeX exponent is empty to preserve command structure without leaving English prose.
General truth/function words do not attest these formal compounds. English OLP-0031 defines truth functions as functions on finite bit tuples, with formal details preserved.

javanese: ora bisa didhaptar; metodhe diagonal; diagonalisasi
rationale: Non-enumerable is the explicit negation of the source-defined listing property, not a claim about computability. Diagonal terminology is provisional borrowing. Preserve the construction's dependence on each proposed list and the iff in diagonal set membership.
Here reduction transforms a proposed enumeration, with the direction controlled by the English surjection/injection construction. No effective or computable reduction condition is implied.

javanese: padha cacahe; gedhene himpunan; ora luwih gedhe tinimbang; luwih cilik tinimbang
rationale: General cacah provides count vocabulary, but the formal meaning for infinite sets is defined by bijections. At-most comparison is by injection; strict comparison additionally excludes bijection. No native attestation of transfinite cardinality is claimed.

english: source repairs in Functions: left inverse, principal square root, input variable, graph relation, function restriction
javanese: A ora kosong; oyod kuadrat utama kang ora negatif; x ajeg; relasi antarane A lan B kang kaemot ing A×B; watesan fungsi mung ing koordinat masukan
rationale: Apply confirmed bounded English-source corrections visibly in OLP-0021, OLP-0023 and OLP-0024 without changing frozen English bytes. The simple theorem body requires nonempty A; the adjacent note records the exact condition A nonempty or B empty. Function restriction remains domain-only. This is source-audit evidence, not Javanese canon or retrospective consultation.

Adapt the international technical stem under the official borrowing policy. In this chapter it means constructing number systems within naive set theory, not assigning Goedel numbers to syntax. The chapter editorial fixes that sense.

english: construction of integers as equivalence classes; embedding natural numbers as integers
javanese: pambangunan wilangan wutuh minangka kelas ekuivalensi; nganggep wilangan natural minangka wilangan wutuh
rationale: OLP-0042 constructs integers as equivalence classes of ordered natural-number pairs and uses n subscript Int for the canonical representative. Preserve the distinction between constructed objects and the natural numbers represented inside them; no specialized native attestation claimed.
